message.reasoning_content:
The kernel is Richardson iteration: state += rhs - A@state. Convergence requires spectral radius |1-λ| < 1 for all eigenvalues; eigenvalues include 1.75 → 1-1.75 = -0.75, and 0.03125 → 0.96875. So converges; after 64 steps error ~0.96875^64 ≈ 0.13 for the smallest-eigen component, plus 0.75^64 negligible. But with normalized rhs, components in that eigendirection... need to compute. rhs is a random unit vector; component along the 0.03125 eigenvector (Hadamard) could be ~0.1-0.3. Error in that direction: initial error = -x component = -c/0.03125 which could be large; multiplied by 0.13 → relative error could exceed 0.08. Need to run probe.

Record claim and probe.
